hints.inbox: An inbox for intent, before it becomes a task. Clarify the desired direction.
hints.clarify: Answer questions and review the brief before moving into design.
hints.design: Design the accepted brief, identify dependencies, and define the change scope.
hints.approval: Review the design and plan. Approval adds the task to the build queue.
hints.queued: Collect approved tasks and start them together. Dependencies and priority determine execution order.
hints.build: Agents implement, verify and commit, coordinating parallel work through A2A.
hints.unconfirmed: Implementation and commits are ready. Review the result and confirm once.
hints.done: You confirmed the result. Changes and decisions remain in the history.
hints.discarding: An agent reverts the recorded commits and verifies the result.
hints.cancelled: Cancelled before implementation. Intent and design history are preserved.
